sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION Our
net tangible book value as of June 30, 2026 was approximately $6,853,335 or $0.11 per share. Net tangible book value is
total assets minus the sum of liabilities and intangible assets. Net tangible book value per share is net tangible book value divided
by the total number of shares of our common stock outstanding as of June 30, 2026. After
giving effect to the sale of up to $3,503,232 of shares of our common stock in this offering at an assumed public offering price
of $0.1860 per share, the last reported sale price of our common stock on the NYSE American on August 27, 2026, and after deducting commissions
and estimated aggregate offering expenses payable by us, our as adjusted net tangible book value as of June 30, 2026 would have been
approximately $10,143,335, or $0.13 per share. This represents an increase in the adjusted net tangible book value of approximately
$0.02
